real_api_target: the ACTUAL rel.authorities and rel.qauth fields of base.IngestedRelease (issuance identity folded into _release_material authority_refs), plus the actual owner interfaces FixtureOwner.revoke / _sign / verify / assert_native_sources / _register_native_sources / compute_native. law: No forged, substituted, stale-epoch, superseded, same-identity-different-body, unissued or cross-universe authority may serve a SUPPORTED original fact. A missing independent issuer or an inexpressible revocation obligation must produce an explicit typed refusal or typed HOLD, never synthetic authority and never an untyped KeyError/TypeError. Honest positives must still serve.
allowed_refusal_exception_note: the adapter law's five typed families plus BatchIntegrityError and the native PRE553 owner's typed integrity/authority family, declared here BEFORE execution; an untyped KeyError/TypeError/AttributeError is always a RED
supported_fact_definition: a served effect entry whose cells carry a supported cell state (OBSERVED_POSITIVE or OBSERVED_ZERO_IN_SUPPORTED_RISK_SET); served_supported_original_fact means at least one such supported original fact was served
uniform_negative_invariants: no supported original fact is served even if an in-band typed UNAVAILABLE state is returned
refusal is typed (allowed exception family or allowed typed token)
no inherited expectation file is edited
